name: html-whole-element-link-dropped-finding
description: A whole-element link wrapping content that has no native link-bearing inner block (a media-only card) emits a structured 'source link wrapper dropped / content no longer navigable' finding carrying the source selector and href so a downstream repair loop can act on it (#260). The group never carries a dead href.

source_reference.notes: Generic structural coverage: an <a href> wrapping a core/video (no text/image/heading inner block can receive the link). The link is non-preservable natively, so the finding is emitted rather than a dead href.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.

expect.value: source link wrapper dropped / content no longer navigable
